contentText:
Ciara reflects on the biggest songs of her career for Billboard Chart History and shares the stories behind hits such as “Goodies,” “1, 2 Step,” “Oh,” “Like a Boy,” “Promise,” “Love Sex Magic,” “Ride,” “Body Party,” “Level Up” and more! From early breakout moments to career-defining collaborations, Ciara opens up about songwriting, dance, visuals, independence and the records that helped shape her legacy.

She also talks about working with legendary collaborators including Missy Elliott, Ludacris, Justin Timberlake, Chris Brown, Chamillionaire and Lil Jon. Ciara shares how songs including “Goodies” and “Level Up” changed her life, why “1, 2 Step” remains a fan favorite and what made records such as “Body Party,” “Promise,” and “Ride” such important creative moments in her journey.

Ciara: Hey, guys. It’s Ciara here, and this is my Billboard Chart History.

Keep watching for more!
